column1: # producer   by hand: whether a text's Strong numbers laid from another edition may be served, read by forge convert
# A translation without tags of its own takes Strong numbers from a numbered edition of the same translation
# (SideStrongNumbers). Those numbers always feed the mapping. They go into the served database only where the
# terms of the numbering itself, not the text's, allow it: the owner's answer on TSK-1443 (2026-11-04) is to
# show only the numbers whose terms allow it, and to use the others, and any whose terms were not read, for the
# mapping only. A laid text missing from this file is not served.
#   numbering  whose numbering it is, and where it is read from
#   file       where its terms were read, under Resources/ or at the address given
#   why        the verdict and what it rests on
